FIELDS.NAME: Fresh and Clean Laundry Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Fresh and Clean Laundry Services offers a full range of laundry and dry cleaning services, including wash-and-fold, dry cleaning, and linen supply for clients such as hotels and restaurants. Our operations are centered around a state-of-the-art facility staffed by trained professionals who ensure high-quality service and customer satisfaction. We also have strict sanitation protocols in place, particularly for our diaper service, to maintain hygiene standards. Our facility features on-site attendants during all operating hours to enhance customer safety and oversight. We comply with all local, state, and federal regulations, ensuring that our operations are environmentally friendly and adhere to industry standards. This commitment to safety and compliance helps us manage risks effectively while providing reliable laundry solutions to our diverse clientele.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Laundry services for students and residential clients in multi-unit housing.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 04/15/2023, our facility experienced a minor plumbing leak due to a worn-out pipe, resulting in water damage to a small area of the laundry floor. The amount of loss was approximately $1,200. Repairs were completed, and the status is resolved. No injuries occurred.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class II safe, UL rated for burglary protection, with a capacity of 2,000 lbs.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: On-site security personnel and monitored surveillance systems to enhance the safety and security of the facility.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in any of its operations. The business complies with all local, state, and federal regulations regarding environmental safety.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its business operations. The focus remains on providing high-quality laundry and dry cleaning services to clients.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The Operations Manager, John Smith, is responsible for checking the certificates to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. We maintain a strong compliance record with our insurance provider.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff members are directly employed and trained to maintain high-quality service standards.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and protect our employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services also operates a laundry service for students and residential clients in multi-unit housing. This additional business complements our primary laundry and dry cleaning operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All operations are covered under the existing policy number LND-2023-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on providing laundry and dry cleaning services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our operations focus on providing laundry and dry cleaning services without engaging in equipment rental.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a sound financial position and adheres to responsible financial practices.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond the incidental use in standard laundry operations, in compliance with all safety regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services does not anticipate any catastrophe exposure as we operate in compliance with all safety regulations and maintain strict safety protocols within our facility.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a strict hiring protocol and focuses on creating a safe and compliant work environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Fresh and Clean Laundry Services has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all necessary safety regulations and maintaining a secure operating environment.

reviews: I love this laundromat! It's so convenient to be able to wash my clothes myself with the coin-operated machines, and the staff is always there to help if I need anything. Definitely my go-to place for laundry!
I love the convenience of their 24/7 hours. It's great to have a reliable laundromat that fits my busy schedule.
The wash-and-fold service is a lifesaver! My clothes come back perfectly clean and neatly folded every time.
I appreciate their commitment to safety and cleanliness. The facility is always well-maintained and organized.
The on-site attendants are very helpful and ensure everything runs smoothly. Highly recommend this place!
